merged_prs.title: Add CSV export for analytics dashboard
merged_prs.summary: Allows users to export aggregated analytics dashboards directly to CSV format.

merged_prs.title: Support webhook event subscriptions
merged_prs.summary: Enables external systems to subscribe to real-time events via custom webhooks.

merged_prs.title: Implement role-based access control for teams
merged_prs.summary: Adds granular role-based permissions (Admin, Editor, Viewer) for workspace teams.

merged_prs.title: Add multi-language localization for UI
merged_prs.summary: Adds multilingual interface translations for Spanish, French, and German locales.

merged_prs.title: Fix memory leak in background queue worker
merged_prs.summary: Resolves uncollected database cursors leaking memory in background queue workers.

merged_prs.title: Resolve race condition in payment checkout
merged_prs.summary: Fixes an intermittent race condition causing duplicate charges during rapid click checkout.

merged_prs.title: Correct timezone calculation on weekly email digest
merged_prs.summary: Ensures weekly email digest statistics respect the recipient's configured timezone.

merged_prs.title: Drop legacy TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 cipher suites
merged_prs.summary: Disables outdated TLS 1.0 and 1.1 protocols; clients must support TLS 1.2 or higher.

# Release Notes

## Features
- [#111] Export analytics dashboards directly to CSV format.
- [#112] Subscribe to real-time events via custom webhooks.
- [#113] Manage team permissions with role-based access controls.
- [#114] Access user interface in Spanish, French, and German.

## Fixes
- [#115] Fixed memory leak in the background queue processor.
- [#116] Resolved intermittent race condition during checkout.
- [#117] Corrected user timezone calculations in weekly email digests.

## Breaking Changes
- [#118] Deprecated and disabled connections using TLS 1.0 and 1.1; TLS 1.2+ is now required.
